_doc: The promenade units' second pass (x_w1_units.json, see strings/x_w1_units.json): every trade's new things and counter talk. Rules name the things as promenade_unit/<thing id>; ids are the same in every unit of a trade. The running stories (cafe machine -> repair shop -> fish shop's valve, the dumpling/pasty peace, the lost book, the Race to the Buoy) are daily boards.
